name: NgHivEacRegister
title: NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register
description:
Logical model for the patient-level Nigeria Enhanced Adherence Counselling
Monitoring Register. One model instance represents one facility monthly cohort
page and contains repeatable client entries corresponding to printed columns
A1 through A24.

mapping.name: NG HIV EAC Monitoring Register Column Mapping
mapping.comment: Maps logical-model elements to the printed A1–A24 Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register columns.

element.short: NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register
element.definition:
Logical model for the patient-level Nigeria Enhanced Adherence Counselling
Monitoring Register. One model instance represents one facility monthly cohort
page and contains repeatable client entries corresponding to printed columns
A1 through A24.
Identifier assigned to the monthly EAC register page or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the facility maintaining the EAC register, when available.
Official name of the facility providing Enhanced Adherence Counselling services.
Local Government Area where the facility is located.
State where the facility is located.
Monthly cohort period. The month should correspond to the month the qualifying viral-load result was received at the facility.
One patient-level row of the Enhanced Adherence Counselling Monitoring Register.
